requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery include Chuck-a-Luck with requirement, module, version, and visual traceability.

requirements.description: Chuck-a-Luck publishes bounded settled-round history through provider-current callbacks that replace only game-owned fields. Competing processes preserve unrelated player-state siblings and fail closed before a stale round can overwrite the winning journal, while committed debit and credit recovery retains the frozen v1 behavior and exactly-once ledger movements.
requirements.notes: The frozen v1 contract, dice, paytable, ledger transaction types, and action keys remain unchanged. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because wallet and game-state publication remain separate durable boundaries.
